title: Rebuild Premium Ayurvedic Skincare Website

requirements.text: Implement a full-page Hero section with a premium Ayurvedic brand headline, subheadline, and a primary CTA button. Use deep forest green (#0B3D2E) as primary, warm beige (#F5E6D3) as background, and soft gold (#C9A96E) accents. Include a high-quality background image of herbs/botanicals. Apply fade-in and slide-up entrance animations.

quotes: Hero section with premium Ayurvedic branding

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section renders with brand headline using Playfair Display or Cinzel serif font
Background features a botanical/herb imagery
CTA button uses soft gold accent color
Fade-in and slide-up animations play on page load

requirements.text: Build a Featured Products section displaying product cards with glassmorphism-style soft card UI. Each card shows product image, name, price, and an Add to Cart button. Cards should have smooth hover animations (scale + shadow lift). Use the existing React Query product fetch hook to populate products.

quotes: Use glassmorphism or soft card UI for product sections

acceptanceCriteria: Product cards use glassmorphism styling with soft shadows and rounded corners
Hover state triggers scale and shadow animation
Products are fetched from backend via existing React Query hook
Add to Cart button is visible and functional on each card

requirements.text: Add a Benefits section highlighting three core values: '100% Natural', 'Chemical-Free', and 'Handmade'. Each benefit should be displayed as an icon card with a short description. Use light sage green (#A8B5A2) as the section background. Apply slide-up animation on scroll entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Three benefit cards are displayed: 100% Natural, Chemical-Free, Handmade
Section background uses light sage green (#A8B5A2)
Each card contains an icon and short descriptive text
Slide-up animation triggers on scroll

requirements.text: Create a Testimonials section with at least three customer quotes displayed in clean, minimal cards. Include customer name, a star rating, and the quote text. Use warm beige (#F5E6D3) background and earthy brown (#6B4F3A) text for depth.
acceptanceCriteria: At least three testimonials are displayed
Each testimonial card shows customer name, star rating, and quote
Section uses warm beige background and earthy brown typography
Layout is clean and well-spaced

requirements.text: Build an 'About Ayurveda' storytelling section with a rich narrative about Ayurvedic heritage, a botanical texture image, and a golden accent divider line. Use elegant serif headings and body text in clean sans-serif (Lato or Poppins). Layout should be two-column on desktop, single-column on mobile.

quotes: Add golden accent lines or dividers

acceptanceCriteria: Section contains storytelling copy about Ayurvedic heritage
A golden (#C9A96E) accent divider line is present
Two-column layout on desktop, stacked on mobile
Serif font used for headings, sans-serif for body

requirements.text: Ensure the floating WhatsApp contact button is visible on all customer-facing pages. It must fetch the WhatsApp number from the backend (with fallback), open a pre-filled WhatsApp chat on click, and include an entrance animation, tooltip, and pulse ring effect. Fix any stale cache issue so the button always reflects the latest number saved via admin settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Floating WhatsApp button appears on all customer pages
Button fetches the current number from backend; fallback number is used if fetch fails
Clicking opens a WhatsApp chat with a pre-filled message
Entrance animation, tooltip, and pulse ring are rendered
After admin saves a new WhatsApp number, the button reflects it without a page reload (React Query cache invalidated)

requirements.text: Design a premium Footer section with the brand name/logo, quick navigation links (Home, Shop, About), contact details, social media placeholders, a golden accent divider, and a copyright line. Keep it minimal, dark (deep forest green background), and elegant.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer uses deep forest green (#0B3D2E) background with light/beige text
Brand name, nav links, contact info, and copyright are present
Golden accent divider separates footer from main content
Layout is responsive and looks premium on mobile

requirements.text: Apply the full Ayurvedic design system globally: deep forest green (#0B3D2E) primary, warm beige (#F5E6D3) background, soft gold (#C9A96E) accents, earthy brown (#6B4F3A) depth, light sage green (#A8B5A2) subtle sections. Use Playfair Display or Cinzel for all headings and Lato or Poppins for body text. Ensure consistent use of whitespace, soft shadows, smooth rounded corners, and subtle nature-inspired background patterns throughout the site.

quotes: Use a rich and elegant Ayurvedic-inspired palette
Headings: Use an elegant serif font
Body text: Use a clean sans-serif font
Minimal, clean layout with lots of whitespace

acceptanceCriteria: All five brand colors are applied consistently across sections
Playfair Display or Cinzel is used for all headings site-wide
Lato or Poppins is used for all body text
Soft shadows, rounded corners, and whitespace are consistent throughout
No overly bright or off-brand colors appear on any page

requirements.text: Ensure full mobile responsiveness across all sections: hero, products, benefits, testimonials, about, and footer. Buttons must be large and tappable. Typography must scale appropriately. The premium look must be maintained at all mobile breakpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: All sections reflow correctly on screens 375px and wider
Buttons have a minimum touch target of 44px height
Font sizes scale down gracefully on small screens
No horizontal overflow or layout breakage on mobile

constraints: Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All backend logic must remain in the single Motoko actor at backend/main.mo
Preserve all existing admin panel functionality (products, orders, users, settings)
nonGoals: Adding new backend data models beyond what already exists
Building new admin panel pages or features
Adding real-time features or WebSocket communication
